clauses.text: A fingerprint-matching decline surfaces in the triage prompt as advisory data under compatible (current) provenance.

A decline is injected only when each recorded version field's content hash (<label>@<hash>) still equals the current worktree asset file's hash ("in force"); an entry whose recorded hash differs from the current governed file (superseded) or whose PRD family differs is retained for audit but withheld from injection.
The retro path emits a ratifiable lens proposal without directly mutating prompts/lenses/ files.
metrics.registry.rematched is emitted to run metrics, and a fixture proves an injected matching precedent can still be triaged legitimate (no suppression).

A two-consecutive-run corpus with a panel member below 25% unique-legit yield emits a ratifiable panel-shrink proposal (no unratified panel change); a three-verifier-run corpus below the behavioral-signal threshold emits a ratifiable verifier-revert-to-opt-in proposal (§9 proposal-mode enforcement, no config self-mutation).
